description: This file implements the ContextGL class, providing OpenGL-specific functionality for a GL context within the ANGLE project. It includes methods for creating various GL resources, managing rendering state, and interfacing with the renderer.

classes.name: ContextGL
classes.description: Implements OpenGL-specific context functionality, resource creation, state management, and renderer interfacing within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the ContextGL instance; currently a no-op returning continue.

methods.name: createCompiler
methods.description: Creates a new CompilerGL instance.

methods.name: createShader
methods.description: Creates a ShaderGL object for a given shader state.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a ProgramGL object for a given program state.

methods.name: createFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a FramebufferGL object with a generated framebuffer.

methods.name: createTexture
methods.description: Creates a TextureGL object with a generated texture and binds it.

methods.name: createRenderbuffer
methods.description: Creates a RenderbufferGL object with a generated renderbuffer and binds it.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Creates a BufferGL object for a given buffer state.

methods.name: createVertexArray
methods.description: Creates a VertexArrayGL object for a given vertex array state.

methods.name: createQuery
methods.description: Creates a query object, either SyncQueryGL or StandardQueryGL based on type.

methods.name: createFenceNV
methods.description: Creates a FenceNVGL or FenceNVSyncGL object depending on support.

methods.name: createSync
methods.description: Creates a SyncGL object.

methods.name: createTransformFeedback
methods.description: Creates a TransformFeedbackGL object.

methods.name: createSampler
methods.description: Creates a SamplerGL object.

methods.name: createProgramPipeline
methods.description: Creates a ProgramPipelineGL object.

methods.name: createPaths
methods.description: Generates a range of PathGL objects.

methods.name: createMemoryObject
methods.description: Creates a MemoryObjectGL object.

methods.name: createSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a SemaphoreGL object.

methods.name: createOverlay
methods.description: Creates an OverlayImpl object (not implemented).

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the renderer.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finishes rendering operations.

methods.name: setDrawArraysState
methods.description: Sets up state for draw arrays, including client attribute synchronization.

methods.name: setDrawElementsState
methods.description: Sets up state for draw elements, including primitive restart handling.

methods.name: drawArrays
methods.description: Performs a draw arrays call, handling multiview if needed.

methods.name: drawArraysInstanced
methods.description: Performs an instanced draw arrays call.

methods.name: updateAttributesForBaseInstance
methods.description: Updates vertex attributes for a given base instance.

methods.name: resetUpdatedAttributes
methods.description: Resets vertex attributes to their original state after base instance updates.

methods.name: drawArraysInstancedBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws arrays with a base instance, using extension if available or emulating.

methods.name: drawElements
methods.description: Draws elements, handling multiview if needed.

methods.name: drawElementsBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: drawElementsInstanced
methods.description: Draws instanced elements.

methods.name: drawElementsInstancedBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws instanced elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: drawElementsInstancedBaseVertexBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws instanced elements with base vertex and base instance, using extension if available or emulating.

methods.name: drawRangeElements
methods.description: Draws range of elements, handling multiview if needed.

methods.name: drawRangeElementsBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws range of elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: drawArraysIndirect
methods.description: Performs indirect draw arrays.

methods.name: drawElementsIndirect
methods.description: Performs indirect draw elements.

methods.name: stencilFillPath
methods.description: Delegates to renderer to stencil fill a path.

methods.name: stencilStrokePath
methods.description: Delegates to renderer to stencil stroke a path.

methods.name: coverFillPath

methods.description: Delegates to renderer to cover stroke a path.

methods.description: Delegates to renderer to stencil then cover fill a path.

methods.description: Delegates to renderer to stencil then cover stroke a path.

methods.name: coverFillPathInstanced
methods.description: Delegates to renderer to cover fill paths instanced.

methods.name: coverStrokePathInstanced
methods.description: Delegates to renderer to cover stroke paths instanced.

methods.description: Delegates to renderer to stencil fill paths instanced.

methods.description: Returns the current graphics reset status.

methods.name: insertEventMarker
methods.description: Inserts an event marker for debugging.

methods.description: Pops a debug group.

methods.description: Validates the current GL state.
